description: This file defines the AuthAPI class for handling authentication-related network operations in a Swift iOS application. It includes data models for request and response payloads, such as login, refresh, logout requests, and token response parsing. The AuthAPI class provides methods for login, token refresh, logout, and fetching user info via HTTP requests to an API server. It uses URLSession for network communication, Codable for JSON encoding/decoding, and encapsulates API interaction details inside a singleton.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: A singleton class encapsulating authentication API calls such as login, refresh, logout, and get current user credentials.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, retrieves token pair from server.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a provided refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the refresh token on the backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user info from the backend using an access token.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts backend token response to TokenPair, setting expiration as current time plus seconds.

methods.name: requireHTTP
methods.description: Ensures the URL response is an HTTPURLResponse, throws an error otherwise.
